loadOrder.notes: A reasonable Medieval Overhaul compatibility mod to have active regardless, but it turned out NOT to be the fix for the Utility NullReferenceException crash -- see the lanternvillage.thelanternvillage entry below and IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md for the real cause and fix.

loadOrder.name: The Lantern Village
loadOrder.notes: Must be positioned here, BEFORE Medieval Overhaul, in the actual ModsConfig.xml activeMods list -- not just in About.xml's loadBefore. Verse.LoadedModManager.CreateModClasses() instantiates every active mod's Mod-derived class in ModsConfig.xml list order; loadBefore/loadAfter only affects Def/content loading order, not this earlier phase. This mod's own Mod-class constructor applies a Harmony finalizer patch that guards a real bug in MedievalOverhaul.MedievalOverhaulSettings's constructor (see CompatPatch_MedievalOverhaul.cs), and that patch must be in place before RimWorld constructs Medieval Overhaul's own Mod class -- with loadBefore alone (and this entry still last in ModsConfig.xml) the patch still applied too late and the crash still happened; this entry's position is the actual fix for that -- see IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md for whether this was confirmed by a real relaunch.
